purpose: Traceability lookup. Read complete relevant flow objects for effects/recovery. Register controls added during implementation.

controls.label: Explore sample workspace
controls.behavior: Navigate through the demo session entry to /app/home, preserving the documented sample-state policy.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy

controls.label: Sign in
controls.behavior: Open /auth/sign-in with a trusted local return path.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy

controls.label: Get started
controls.behavior: Open /auth/sign-up; optional public profile link remains available.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy

controls.label: View sample freelancer
controls.behavior: Open /u/alya and render only the approved public projection.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy

controls.label: View service
controls.behavior: Open the selected /u/[handle]/services/[slug] route with package scope, price/basis and approved work samples.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy

controls.label: Open work sample
controls.behavior: Open the approved sample in an app-owned accessible lightbox or its declared safe public URL. No owner-only source payload is included.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy

controls.label: Start an inquiry
controls.behavior: Open the inquiry form with optional service reference and a concise AI-representative disclosure.
controls.enabled_when: approved public service/profile permits inquiry intake

controls.label: Your name
controls.behavior: Update contact-name draft only.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy

controls.label: Email
controls.behavior: Update contact email draft only.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy
controls.validation: Valid email format; no claim of verified identity.

controls.label: What do you need?
controls.behavior: Update requested work, optional budget/currency and desired timing draft. Preserve original wording.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy
controls.validation: Nonempty request; if supplied budget is nonnegative and has a currency; explicit date/timezone for any confirmed date.

controls.label: Budget and currency (optional)
controls.behavior: Edit optional budget and currency without guessing unknown values.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy
controls.validation: Nonnegative exact amount plus currency, or omitted/unknown.

controls.label: Desired timing (optional)
controls.behavior: Edit desired date/duration and timezone as a request, not a confirmed deadline.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy
controls.validation: Valid date/duration and timezone when entered; ambiguous wording remains a clarification.

controls.label: Send inquiry
controls.behavior: Validate and atomically create/link the complete isolated inquiry aggregate, then navigate to /inquiry/[engagementID] returned by the command.
controls.enabled_when: approved public profile/service still available; inquiry form open; no submit in flight; command validates required input before creating isolated inquiry
controls.validation: Required name/email/request, current approved public service/profile, typed optional fields and idempotency. Resolve client linkage only through an explicitly authorized existing-client context; public email/domain matching alone cannot reuse an existing client engagement, conversation or grant.

controls.label: Cancel inquiry
controls.behavior: Close inquiry form without creating records; prompt only if a dirty draft would be lost.
controls.enabled_when: public entry/profile/service exists and approved projection is available; any submitted form is not busy

controls.label: Message
controls.behavior: Edit buyer message draft; multiline Enter policy is shown (Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline where configured).
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped inquiry/conversation exists; relevant composer or brief editor is open and not busy
controls.validation: Nonempty after trimming; bounded length; safely render source text.

controls.label: Send message
controls.behavior: Persist the buyer message once and start the applicable deterministic Sales clarification/assessment intent. Unsupported free text is saved and receives an honest clarification/manual owner follow-up option.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped conversation; nonempty draft within limits; no send in flight; command validates current conversation and attachment state
controls.validation: Nonempty draft, current scoped conversation and expected version; do not infer binding dates from ambiguous relative wording.

controls.label: Review your brief
controls.behavior: Expand the saved structured brief, distinguish requests from suggestions, and show outstanding clarifications.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped inquiry/conversation exists; relevant composer or brief editor is open and not busy

controls.label: Correct brief
controls.behavior: Open editable buyer-provided requirement fields; owner-only assessments remain absent.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped inquiry/conversation exists; relevant composer or brief editor is open and not busy

controls.label: Requested scope
controls.behavior: Update requested deliverables draft.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped inquiry/conversation exists; relevant composer or brief editor is open and not busy
controls.validation: Nonempty scope for assessment; preserve requested versus proposed distinction.

controls.label: Budget and currency
controls.behavior: Edit known budget/currency; allow explicitly unknown.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped inquiry/conversation exists; relevant composer or brief editor is open and not busy
controls.validation: Exact numeric amount with currency, or unknown; do not coerce missing to zero.

controls.label: Timing and timezone
controls.behavior: Edit requested timing and timezone; distinguish desired date from confirmed commitment.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped inquiry/conversation exists; relevant composer or brief editor is open and not busy
controls.validation: Valid date/duration and timezone when present; ambiguous wording asks clarification.

controls.label: Save brief
controls.behavior: Save a new requirements version and schedule dependent sample reassessment; show material changes needing owner review.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped requirements editor open; requirements not stale; no save in flight; only buyer-provided requirements may change
controls.validation: Valid typed fields and expected requirements version; stale state presents reload/review.

controls.label: Cancel brief edits
controls.behavior: Discard uncommitted edits through the shared overlay contract.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped inquiry/conversation exists; relevant composer or brief editor is open and not busy

controls.label: Ask the freelancer
controls.behavior: Save an owner-follow-up request and show that the request is pending.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped inquiry and owner-follow-up request absent or replay returns same pending request
controls.validation: Scoped conversation; deduplicate repeated pending request.

controls.label: View offer
controls.behavior: Open /buyer/[id]/offer only when an eligible shared or historical accepted offer exists.
controls.enabled_when: buyer has a shared/accepted offer reference

controls.label: Play voice sample
controls.behavior: Open labeled sample transcript and speech controls. Feature-detect speechSynthesis and enumerate voices; only a suitable voice with localService === true may enable playback. Otherwise show transcript-only unavailable reason.
controls.enabled_when: sample transcript exists

controls.label: Play sample
controls.behavior: After explicit user activation, speak stored sample transcript using a specifically selected SpeechSynthesisVoice with localService === true. Assign that exact voice to utterance.voice before speak; never use default/remote voice fallback. Resume only the existing eligible local sample when supported.
controls.enabled_when: speechSynthesis available and suitable selected voice has localService === true; stopped or paused local sample; no remote/default-voice fallback
controls.validation: Recheck selected voice.localService === true immediately before speak; set utterance.voice explicitly. If no suitable local voice exists or voices change, disable playback with transcript-only fallback. Never submit transcript/audio to remote service.

controls.label: Pause sample
controls.behavior: Pause the actual current speech utterance and reflect the confirmed pause callback; do not advance a fake waveform/progress clock.
controls.enabled_when: current sample utterance playing and pause supported
controls.validation: If pause cannot be confirmed, offer Stop and transcript fallback rather than pretending paused.

controls.label: Stop sample
controls.behavior: Cancel the actual sample utterance and return playback to stopped; preserve transcript and saved conversation.
controls.enabled_when: sample utterance active or paused
controls.validation: Cancel only the application sample; clean up handlers and errors.

controls.label: Close sample
controls.behavior: Stop/cancel the actual sample speech and close player; restore opener focus.
controls.enabled_when: sample panel open

controls.label: Continue by text
controls.behavior: Stop sample speech and focus the actual saved conversation composer.
controls.enabled_when: conversation exists

controls.label: Search leads
controls.behavior: Search client/request/source text with current filters/sort and query stored in URL.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace lead list loaded

controls.label: Status
controls.behavior: Filter leads by domain status while keeping search and source filters.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace lead list loaded

controls.label: Source
controls.behavior: Filter by recorded source/channel, including unknown.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace lead list loaded

controls.label: Sort leads
controls.behavior: Sort deterministically by selected supported field with ID tie-breaker.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace lead list loaded

controls.label: Clear filters
controls.behavior: Clear search/filter values, reset paging and show the correct empty versus no-results state.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace lead list loaded

controls.label: Open lead
controls.behavior: Navigate to the exact /app/opportunities/[id], preserving list return query.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace lead list loaded

controls.label: Add lead
controls.behavior: Open the new lead form without committing any record.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace lead list loaded

controls.label: Import request
controls.behavior: Open the explicit sample import/paste flow; do not imply broad web discovery.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace lead list loaded

controls.label: Client or lead name
controls.behavior: Edit display name and select existing client only when the owner deliberately chooses one.
controls.enabled_when: owner has new-lead form or editable existing lead loaded with expected version; not busy
controls.validation: Nonempty bounded name; do not merge merely by email/domain.

controls.label: Original request
controls.behavior: Edit/paste the request with requested scope, budget/currency and desired timing as separate fields where known.
controls.enabled_when: owner has new-lead form or editable existing lead loaded with expected version; not busy
controls.validation: Nonempty request; budget+currency valid or unknown; desired dates are not commitments.

controls.label: Source or reference
controls.behavior: Store source type/title/URL and owner notes; a URL is metadata until a supported mock import supplies content.
controls.enabled_when: owner has new-lead form or editable existing lead loaded with expected version; not busy
controls.validation: Allowed URL scheme or text metadata; safe rendering; no arbitrary fetch.

controls.label: Import text file or paste CSV
controls.behavior: Read allowed local TXT (max10MiB) or parse pasted CSV text; preview request rows and mappings before saving. Root attachment contract remains PDF/PNG/JPEG/TXT, max10MiB each and max5 per action; this request parser accepts TXT/plain text only and must not imply PDF extraction.
controls.enabled_when: owner has new-lead form or editable existing lead loaded with expected version; not busy
controls.validation: TXT MIME/extension and max10MiB, safe plain-text/CSV-content parse and required-column mapping; unsupported CSV file/PDF/ZIP yields clear explanation and paste-text option.

controls.label: Remove import
controls.behavior: Clear the uncommitted imported content/attachment and restore the preceding editable draft.
controls.enabled_when: uncommitted import exists

controls.label: Save lead
controls.behavior: Validate and persist the new lead or a new version of existing request/source facts; open its canonical detail.
controls.enabled_when: owner new/edit form open with expected opportunity/source version; nonempty required request/name; no save in flight; accepted snapshots excluded
controls.validation: Required request/name, typed fields, mapped import rows, expected version; dedupe command and disclose possible existing record instead of automatic merge.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.behavior: Close without changing committed records; confirm discard only if dirty.
controls.enabled_when: owner has new-lead form or editable existing lead loaded with expected version; not busy

controls.label: View source
controls.behavior: Open deep-linkable source drawer with original text, title, date/version, URL and fact-state labels.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view this lead and its selected source reference; source drawer open where required

controls.label: Open original link
controls.behavior: Open declared safe source URL with appropriate new-tab protection, or show unavailable when absent. No credentials are assumed.
controls.enabled_when: safe URL exists
controls.validation: Allowlisted http/https URL and safe rendering.

controls.label: Refresh sample source
controls.behavior: Run the supported mock source refresh; compare returned source version before applying changed facts.
controls.enabled_when: valid owner source reference with supported sample refresh capability and current expected version; no refresh in flight
controls.validation: Supported mock source/capability available and expected version.

controls.label: Replace request source
controls.behavior: Open lead editor/import with current source, preserving the existing committed version until save.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view this lead and its selected source reference; source drawer open where required

controls.label: Close source
controls.behavior: Close panel and restore activating control/list context.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view this lead and its selected source reference; source drawer open where required

controls.label: Ask Scout to assess
controls.behavior: Create one deterministic Scout assessment task using current request/profile/source versions.
controls.enabled_when: lead has original request and current source/profile refs; no equivalent active assessment run; owner can start sample Scout task
controls.validation: Current inputs and allowed sample capability; idempotent while an equivalent active task exists.

controls.label: Inspect assessment
controls.behavior: Open concise fit/gaps/evidence with version freshness; detailed diagnostics remain in Team.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view current lead; no accepted-history overwrite; relevant assessment or action exists

controls.label: Qualify lead
controls.behavior: Record deliberate owner qualification and next step, even if additional nonblocking facts remain unknown.
controls.enabled_when: lead is new/needs_information/assessing with reviewable current facts; no stale required assessment; expected lead version current
controls.validation: Current lead version; explain any missing required facts before confirmation; no inferred customer agreement.

controls.label: Request missing information
controls.behavior: Open a buyer-safe question draft; sending uses the applicable exact-content/destination review flow.
controls.enabled_when: lead has a known buyer contact or a draft destination to select; only internal question draft is created
controls.validation: Known recipient or owner-provided destination; no automatic external send.

controls.label: Decline lead
controls.behavior: Open decline reason/confirmation with exact lead and consequence; do not send a buyer message.
controls.enabled_when: lead is active and unaccepted; decline confirmation not already open; owner can decline ordinary lead
controls.validation: Expected version; pending commercial commitment must be handled in its own flow.

controls.label: Decline reason (optional)
controls.behavior: Edit short owner-private decline reason.
controls.enabled_when: decline confirmation open
controls.validation: Bounded plain text; may be omitted.

controls.label: Confirm decline
controls.behavior: Decline this exact lead and retain prior state for honest Undo.
controls.enabled_when: decline confirmation open for exact current active unaccepted lead; expected version current; no command in flight
controls.validation: Expected lead version; accepted commitments handled separately.

controls.label: Keep lead
controls.behavior: Close decline confirmation without changing lead.
controls.enabled_when: decline confirmation open

controls.label: Restore lead
controls.behavior: Restore a declined/archived nonaccepted lead to its prior active state.
controls.enabled_when: lead is declined/archived with stored eligible prior state; no accepted-history mutation; no command in flight
controls.validation: No conflict with accepted commercial history.

controls.label: Draft offer
controls.behavior: Open canonical offer editor from this lead using known facts and explicit unknowns.
controls.enabled_when: lead has sufficient client/request context; unresolved required commercial facts remain blocking fields

controls.label: Search offers
controls.behavior: Search client/offer title using combined state filters and URL query.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace offer list loaded

controls.label: Offer status
controls.behavior: Filter by actual offer lifecycle, including awaiting review, shared and accepted.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace offer list loaded

controls.label: Sort offers
controls.behavior: Use supported amount/date/client sort with stable tie-breaker; compare amounts within currency only.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace offer list loaded

controls.label: Clear filters
controls.behavior: Reset list query and distinguish no results from no offers.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace offer list loaded

controls.label: Open offer
controls.behavior: Open exact /app/offers/[id], preserving list query and latest/history context.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace offer list loaded

controls.label: Create offer
controls.behavior: Open new offer editor and require explicit client/engagement linkage; no accepted project is created.
controls.enabled_when: owner sample session and workspace offer list loaded

controls.label: Client and engagement
controls.behavior: Choose canonical client/contact/engagement for a new offer; existing identity changes require a deliberate new offer.
controls.enabled_when: owner editor open for new/current unaccepted draft or successor revision; accepted snapshot remains read-only; not busy
controls.validation: Explicit existing/new client link; no automatic merge.

controls.label: Deliverables and scope
controls.behavior: Edit profession-neutral deliverables, inclusions/exclusions and required inputs.
controls.enabled_when: owner editor open for new/current unaccepted draft or successor revision; accepted snapshot remains read-only; not busy
controls.validation: Nonempty scope and valid quantities; do not introduce hidden revision/technical promises.

controls.label: Price and currency
controls.behavior: Edit exact gross total and currency; update draft-only deposit and balance preview.
controls.enabled_when: owner editor open for new/current unaccepted draft or successor revision; accepted snapshot remains read-only; not busy
controls.validation: Positive exact supported amount/currency; safe integer bounds; no binary-float binding arithmetic.

controls.label: Deposit requirement
controls.behavior: Edit deposit according to configured policy; preview exact gross installment amount and remaining balance.
controls.enabled_when: owner editor open for new/current unaccepted draft or successor revision; accepted snapshot remains read-only; not busy
controls.validation: Valid configured basis points; Northstar default 6000; rounding rule explicit; changing it invalidates dependent approval.

controls.label: Delivery basis
controls.behavior: Edit business-day duration and required input/deposit basis; show proposed schedule separately from committed date.
controls.enabled_when: owner editor open for new/current unaccepted draft or successor revision; accepted snapshot remains read-only; not busy
controls.validation: Positive duration; explicit timezone/calendar; sample five days begins after committed start per decisions.

controls.label: Buyer message and terms
controls.behavior: Edit buyer-safe message, expiry and visible terms; internal notes remain separate.
controls.enabled_when: owner editor open for new/current unaccepted draft or successor revision; accepted snapshot remains read-only; not busy
controls.validation: No private assessment/floor/acquisition economics; expiry valid against frozen sample clock.

controls.label: Internal notes
controls.behavior: Edit clearly owner-private draft notes that are excluded from buyer projection and PDF.
controls.enabled_when: owner editor open for new/current unaccepted draft or successor revision; accepted snapshot remains read-only; not busy

controls.label: Save draft
controls.behavior: Validate and save a new immutable draft version under the same logical offer, then show its current state.
controls.enabled_when: new or current unaccepted draft/successor revision editor open; expected version current; no save in flight; incomplete fields may persist as draft but cannot pass review
controls.validation: Expected offer/version, valid terms, required facts and linked records; accepted version cannot be overwritten.

controls.label: Submit for review
controls.behavior: Validate/save the current draft and set awaiting_review with exact inputs.
controls.enabled_when: current complete draft/successor amendment with valid required terms and current Scout/Operations/Finance input refs; expected version current; no command in flight
controls.validation: All required commercial fields and current assessments; block unresolved required facts or mark for explicit review rather than fabricate them.

controls.label: Cancel edits
controls.behavior: Keep the prior committed version; confirm discard only for a dirty draft.
controls.enabled_when: owner editor open for new/current unaccepted draft or successor revision; accepted snapshot remains read-only; not busy

controls.label: Edit offer
controls.behavior: Open editor for an unaccepted draft/current version; accepted state offers amendment instead.
controls.enabled_when: current version editable or an explicit new draft is permitted

controls.label: Why this offer?
controls.behavior: Expand supporting capability, capacity and finance evidence with provenance/unknowns; keep default page calm.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view selected offer/version and its permitted supporting records

controls.label: Version history
controls.behavior: Open read-only version list with creation, approval/share/acceptance and exact snapshot refs.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view selected offer/version and its permitted supporting records

controls.label: Compare versions
controls.behavior: Choose two existing versions and render field-level scope/amount/currency/deposit/delivery/recipient differences.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view selected offer/version and its permitted supporting records
controls.validation: Both versions belong to same offer; do not sum unlike currency.

controls.label: Return to current version
controls.behavior: Close historical comparison and restore current detail without mutating versions.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view selected offer/version and its permitted supporting records

controls.label: Open client
controls.behavior: Navigate to canonical client with offer return context.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view selected offer/version and its permitted supporting records

controls.label: Open project
controls.behavior: Open the accepted offer linked project, if one exists.
controls.enabled_when: accepted project reference exists

controls.label: Review and approve
controls.behavior: Open a concise review of exact terms, buyer-safe content and selected destination/contact. Show material limitations and expiry.
controls.enabled_when: current offer state awaiting_review; owner can inspect exact current terms and intended destination

controls.label: Recipient / sharing destination
controls.behavior: Choose the canonical intended buyer/contact and supported sample channel; changing it updates review snapshot only.
controls.enabled_when: owner review panel for current awaiting_review offer is open; exact version/input refs remain current; not busy
controls.validation: Explicit allowed buyer/contact/destination; never infer arbitrary client access from typed ID.

controls.label: Approve this version
controls.behavior: Approve the displayed exact version, material hash and content/destination snapshot.
controls.enabled_when: current offer awaiting_review; owner review open; exact terms/hash/destination and required input versions current; unexpired; no approval in flight
controls.validation: Expected current version/hash; current required assessments; nonexpired valid terms/destination; prior edit or policy change rejects stale review.

controls.label: Revision instruction
controls.behavior: Enter owner-private requested changes before returning an offer for revision.
controls.enabled_when: review panel open
controls.validation: Nonempty bounded instruction when requesting revision.

controls.label: Request revision
controls.behavior: Record a concise owner instruction and return the current unaccepted offer to draft/revision state.
controls.enabled_when: current awaiting_review offer; nonempty owner revision instruction; exact expected version current; no command in flight
controls.validation: Expected version and nonempty revision instruction.

controls.label: Cancel review
controls.behavior: Close without approving or changing terms.
controls.enabled_when: owner review panel for current awaiting_review offer is open; exact version/input refs remain current; not busy

controls.label: Preview buyer offer
controls.behavior: Open buyer-safe preview generated from explicit shared projection; show exact scope/amount/deposit/timing/expiry and destination. No owner chrome or private economics.
controls.enabled_when: current offer approved with current exact-version/content/destination approval; buyer-safe preview available

controls.label: Change destination
controls.behavior: Return to destination review; changed destination invalidates existing share authorization.
controls.enabled_when: owner preview open before share; selecting a different destination requires new destination-bound approval

controls.label: Share offer in sample
controls.behavior: Persist one sample share to the approved scoped buyer destination, with current version and safe message.
controls.enabled_when: current offer approved, unexpired and unaccepted; exact current hash/version/channel/destination approval; required sample connection capability satisfied; no share in flight
controls.validation: Current approved hash/version/destination/channel; nonexpired; sample connection/capability if channel requires it; safe projection validated.

controls.label: Copy buyer link
controls.behavior: Copy the actual scoped local buyer URL after share; if clipboard unavailable show selectable URL.
controls.enabled_when: eligible saved share exists
controls.validation: Nonrevoked valid share; only scoped public link.

controls.label: Download offer PDF
controls.behavior: Generate an actual buyer-safe PDF for the displayed shared/approved exact snapshot.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view selected exact approved/shared/accepted snapshot; buyer-safe PDF projection exists; no generation in flight
controls.validation: Valid snapshot and projection; document includes version/currency/timing basis without private notes.

controls.label: Close preview
controls.behavior: Close without sharing; prior approval remains unchanged.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view current approved offer with exact version/content/destination-bound approval

controls.label: Withdraw offer
controls.behavior: Open confirmation naming exact unaccepted offer/version and the buyer acceptance consequence.
controls.enabled_when: unaccepted draft/approved/shared offer
controls.validation: Expected version; accepted version requires amendment/cancellation workflow instead.

controls.label: Confirm withdrawal
controls.behavior: Withdraw exact unaccepted version, preserving history; any future re-offer requires fresh eligible draft/review/share.
controls.enabled_when: withdraw confirmation open for exact current unaccepted draft/awaiting_review/approved/shared/change_requested version; not accepted; expected version current; no command in flight
controls.validation: Expected version; reject accepted offer; idempotency.

controls.label: Keep offer
controls.behavior: Close withdrawal confirmation with no changes.
controls.enabled_when: owner can view exact current unaccepted offer/version or expiry event references it

controls.label: Offer expiry reached
controls.behavior: On deliberate sample-clock advancement or read-time validation, derive expired eligibility from saved expiresAt.
controls.enabled_when: unaccepted offer with expiresAt <= deliberate sample clock; expiry transition not yet applied or replay is idempotent
controls.validation: Frozen sample clock >= expiresAt; accepted versions do not lose historical acceptance.

controls.label: Create revised draft
controls.behavior: Create a new draft version from withdrawn/expired terms; require fresh review and share.
controls.enabled_when: owner can create successor of withdrawn/expired/superseded unaccepted version; no existing equivalent draft command in flight; accepted snapshot protected
controls.validation: Expected logical offer version; new expiry/terms valid.

controls.label: Propose amendment
controls.behavior: Create a new version referencing the exact accepted snapshot and show proposed changes separately.
controls.enabled_when: immutable accepted original offer exists; owner may create successor amendment referencing existing project; no duplicate active create command
controls.validation: Current accepted ref and expected version; no implicit cancellation of existing agreement.

controls.label: Amended terms
controls.behavior: Edit scope/price/deposit/timing/message draft using offer field rules and a clear change reason.
controls.enabled_when: owner editable amendment draft exists; original accepted snapshot remains immutable
controls.validation: Explicit changed fields, reason and effects on existing payments/dates; proposed values must be valid.

controls.label: Submit amendment for review
controls.behavior: Save amendment and require fresh exact-content/version/destination approval before sharing.
controls.enabled_when: complete current amendment draft with change reason and fresh capacity/finance assessment; expected version current; no review command in flight
controls.validation: Expected amendment version and current capacity/finance assessments.

controls.label: Cancel amendment draft
controls.behavior: Discard uncommitted edits or archive an ordinary amendment draft with confirmation; leave accepted terms intact.
controls.enabled_when: owner or scoped buyer has accepted original terms and permitted linked amendment context; not busy

controls.label: Review proposed changes
controls.behavior: Show buyer-safe before/after accepted versus proposed terms, including payment/start-date effects and expiry.
controls.enabled_when: amendment is approved and shared to this buyer

controls.label: Accept amendment
controls.behavior: Explicitly accept exact current shared amendment, preserving original acceptance and applying only validated deltas.
controls.enabled_when: valid scoped buyer; current amendment approved and shared to this buyer; exact hash/version/expiry current; delta capacity and financial consistency checked; no accept in flight
controls.validation: Buyer scope, current shared hash/version, expiry, delta capacity and financial consistency; block unresolved overpayment/refund/rescheduling rather than invent it.

controls.label: Search drafts
controls.behavior: Search title/content/client-channel labels using combined URL query filters.
controls.enabled_when: owner promotion list or selected editable draft is loaded; draft editor open where required

controls.label: Status and channel
controls.behavior: Filter by saved lifecycle/channel; maintain current search and sort.
controls.enabled_when: owner promotion list or selected editable draft is loaded; draft editor open where required

controls.label: Clear filters
controls.behavior: Restore all drafts and correct empty state.
controls.enabled_when: owner promotion list or selected editable draft is loaded; draft editor open where required

controls.label: Open draft
controls.behavior: Open deep-linkable draft drawer using ?draft=[id], keeping list context.
controls.enabled_when: owner promotion list or selected editable draft is loaded; draft editor open where required

controls.label: New promotion
controls.behavior: Open editor for a new promotion or curated Promoter task; do not publish.
controls.enabled_when: owner promotion list or selected editable draft is loaded; draft editor open where required

controls.label: Ask Promoter for a draft
controls.behavior: Start deterministic draft task from approved claims and selected channel; preserve unsupported claims as questions.
controls.enabled_when: owner selected supported channel/destination with approved source claims; no equivalent active Promoter task; sample task capability available
controls.validation: Approved claims and supported curated intent; duplicate active request returns same task.

controls.label: Promotion text
controls.behavior: Edit channel-appropriate draft text while preserving provenance of factual claims.
controls.enabled_when: owner promotion list or selected editable draft is loaded; draft editor open where required
controls.validation: Nonempty bounded text; unapproved claim flagged; safe rendering.

controls.label: Channel and destination
controls.behavior: Choose supported sample channel, destination/audience and campaign reference.
controls.enabled_when: owner promotion list or selected editable draft is loaded; draft editor open where required
controls.validation: Explicit destination/channel/audience and known channel rules; unavailable capabilities shown.

controls.label: Save promotion draft
controls.behavior: Save a new content version with exact destination and approved-claim references.
controls.enabled_when: editable current promotion draft/editor exists; expected version current; no save in flight; content/destination fields valid for draft
controls.validation: Expected version, valid draft fields and approved public claims.

controls.label: Archive draft
controls.behavior: Archive an ordinary unaccepted promotion draft with Undo; retain any publication history.
controls.enabled_when: owner selected ordinary unpublished promotion draft or separate editable successor; publication evidence/history preserved; no archive in flight

controls.label: Cancel edits
controls.behavior: Close editor without changing committed content; dirty discard policy applies.

controls.enabled_when: Owner demo session; record belongs to active workspace

controls.label: Close receipt
controls.behavior: Use the same cancellation contract; closing a preview changes no financial record.
controls.enabled_when: Owner demo session; record belongs to active workspace

controls.label: Retry upload
controls.behavior: Retry only the failed file write/link operation using its original operation ID.
controls.enabled_when: Owner demo session; record belongs to active workspace

controls.label: Export scope
controls.behavior: Choose Current filtered results or All expenses including archived; display exact count and currency groups.
controls.enabled_when: Dialogopen

controls.label: Format
controls.behavior: Choose Expenses CSV or Receipt ZIP.
controls.enabled_when: Dialogopen

controls.label: Include estimates
controls.behavior: Explicitly include/exclude estimated rows; every CSV row retains an estimated/recorded classification.
controls.enabled_when: Dialogopen

controls.label: Generate download
controls.behavior: Create actual CSV or ZIP bytes from the reviewed record IDs and versions.
controls.enabled_when: Validscope;notbusy

controls.label: Cancel
controls.behavior: Cancel pending generation or close the review without changing expense records.
controls.enabled_when: Owner demo session; record belongs to active workspace

controls.label: Close export
controls.behavior: Use the shared cancellation/focus-return contract.
controls.enabled_when: Owner demo session; record belongs to active workspace

controls.label: Try export again
controls.behavior: Regenerate the same captured scope after failure; explicitly refresh the scope if source versions changed.
controls.enabled_when: Owner demo session; record belongs to active workspace
